name: Lauren Young Tire (Roseburg-Umpqua Hwy

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large commercial facility with a multi-section white metal building and extensive outdoor storage areas|A large quonset hut is situated at the back left side of the main building|A large paved parking and street surrounds the main building|Hundreds of tires are stored in organized rows across a significant portion of the site

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main white metal building with multiple service bays and garage openings facing the highway|A large paved customer and vehicle staging area is located in front of the building|Extensive tire storage is visible to one side of the property|The site has direct frontage and access from North Umpqua Highway.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side of the main building along with a large outdoor tire storage yard|It also shows the entrance, a large opening, to the quonset hut|Hundreds of tires are stacked and arranged across the open lot|The street and parking lot areas provide vehicle circulation around the storage zone and building.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back of the main building complex with additional service and storage areas|A large tire storage yard extends across much of the rear and side of the property|Open paved and dirt areas allow vehicle movement around the site.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the main building with the extensive tire storage yard|Multiple rows of tires occupy a large portion of the lot|The property has open space and direct road access along North Umpqua Highway.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple points along a street in front and behind the property, into the large paved parking area. The open layout around the main building provides good space for emergency vehicle staging. The extensive outdoor tire storage occupies a significant portion of the property and may limit movement in those zones. The main building has multiple service bay openings. The facility is located in a commercial corridor with neighboring businesses and good road frontage.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the property, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the main building? Are there multiple points of entry into the building itself? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the storage areas or rear of the facility?
